issues.UNKNOWN_DATA_TYPE: The data type is not known.
issues.DEEP_SCAN: “..” searches the whole response — usually a typo for a single dot.
issues.DUPLICATE_ROOT: $ in the middle of the path is read as a field named $.
issues.EMPTY_BRACKETS: Empty brackets are read as [*], all items.
issues.FIELD_WHITESPACE: A field name contains a space, which is part of the name.
issues.UNEXPECTED_PATH_AFTER_ALL: After [*] only status, header or body can follow.

issues.FIELD_ON_ARRAY: This reads a field directly from a list. Pick the items first.

issues.NO_MATCH_IN_SAMPLE: The filter matches nothing in the method's example response.
issues.INVALID_SAMPLE: The method's example response could not be read, so the path was not checked against it.
